tool.title: Sampson 2021 · estimativa de sdLDL-C
tool.methodVersion: Sampson 2021; LDL-C calculado opcional por Sampson–NIH 2020
tool.formula: sdLDL-C = LDL-C − (1,43 × LDL-C − 0,14 × ln(TG) × LDL-C − 8,99), em mg/dL. No modo painel, LDL-C = CT/0,948 − HDL-C/0,971 − (TG/8,56 + TG × (CT − HDL-C)/2140 − TG²/16100) − 9,44. CT, HDL-C e TG em mg/dL. ln indica logaritmo natural.

primarySources.version: Sampson et al. 2021, Clin Chem 67:987–997, DOI10.1093/clinchem/hvab048
primarySources.access: Indexed original PubMed abstract: lbLDL equation and sdLDL subtraction, calibration route using Sampson-estimated LDL-C. PMC/publisher full text blocked in this audit.
primarySources.scope: Arithmetic of lbLDL=1.43LDL−0.14ln(TG)LDL−8.99 and sdLDL=LDL−lbLDL. Direct LDL variant is a local extension and is not represented as published clinical validation.

primarySources.version: Sampson et al. 2020, JAMA Cardiol 5:540–548, DOI10.1001/jamacardio.2020.0013
primarySources.access: Full original primary HTML study methods, TG≤800 mg/dL use, exclusions and limitations read; displayed equation artwork corroborated by ADLM equation.
primarySources.scope: Sampson–NIH LDL-C panel estimation; typeIII hyperlipidemia excluded; no automatic diagnosis.

primarySources.version: ADLM Guidance Document on the Measurement and Reporting of Lipids and Lipoproteins, 2024
primarySources.access: Indexed official ADLM document Eq4, coefficients and mg/dL terms.

tool.limits: Estimativa de subfração lipídica; não equivale à dosagem direta. No modo direto informe LDL-C; no modo painel informe colesterol total e HDL-C. Revisão clínica independente não realizada.
sourceLimitEvidence: Synthetic numerical inputs only; no patient data.
Decimal conformance is not independent clinical validation, diagnostic approval or professional translation approval.
FLI software input bounds can generate mathematically valid stress cases outside a plausible clinical phenotype; no applicability is claimed for those combinations.
Tanaka estimates population sodium excretion, not individual intake. NaCl equivalent conversion does not establish ingestion or dietary advice.
Tanaka publisher full text was unavailable; original indexed abstract coefficients and primary study unit reproduction were read.
Sampson direct-LDL path is verified as an arithmetic extension; 2021 calibration uses Sampson-estimated LDL and is not claimed to validate this extension clinically.
TG800 bound is supported for the Sampson2020 LDL equation; sdLDL estimation and other bounds require population/method review.
No claims about all global formulas, third-party integrations, clinical performance, UI multilingual rendering or deployment are made by this module-only audit.

methodEditionEvidence.policies: Panel-derived LDL is the published2021 calibration input. Measured-LDL direct mode is an arithmetic extension, not a clinically validated equivalence. TG≤800 supports the2020 LDL equation; other bounds are software policies.
